Name: AT Bats
Author: EnbyFelix
Description: Alternative Textures pack to change the ceiling leaves into bats. There are 29 variations. All of them are from the bats from the mines. To get the bats, use the paint bucket from Robin's on the ceiling leaves that are purchased from the Flower Dance and the Luau.
